objective: Certificar en solo lectura que la correccion R7 de Ventas Cerradas ya opera en runtime: los ciclos automaticos INCR posteriores a 2026-09-28T23:37:58Z deben alcanzar las 5 sucursales, y Scheduler_BitacoraJobs debe registrar FINISH para sync_comercial_v2. Verificar tambien que no queden ejecuciones START sin FINISH posteriores a la integracion. No modificar codigo ni datos. No tocar sync_comercial_abiertas_v2. Etiqueta: Sincronizador.

queries.name: automatic_runs_after_r7
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (20) run_id,MIN(run_timestamp) AS primero,MAX(run_timestamp) AS ultimo,COUNT(DISTINCT unidad_negocio_id) AS unidades,COUNT(*) AS logs,SUM(CASE WHEN status='SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exitosos,SUM(CASE WHEN status<>'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_exitosos FROM dbo.Comercial_SyncLog_v2 WHERE run_type='INCREMENTAL' AND run_id LIKE 'INCR-%' AND run_timestamp>'2026-09-28T23:37:58' GROUP BY run_id ORDER BY primero DESC

queries.name: latest_auto_run_units_named
queries.sql: WITH latest AS (SELECT TOP (1) run_id FROM dbo.Comercial_SyncLog_v2 WHERE run_type='INCREMENTAL' AND run_id LIKE 'INCR-%' AND run_timestamp>'2026-09-28T23:37:58' ORDER BY run_timestamp DESC) SELECT l.run_id,u.codigo,u.nombre,s.run_timestamp,s.fecha_inicio,s.fecha_fin,s.status,s.source_connection_status,s.error_code,s.error_message FROM dbo.Comercial_SyncLog_v2 s JOIN latest l ON l.run_id=s.run_id LEFT JOIN dbo.Unidades_Negocio u ON CONVERT(varchar(36),u.id)=CONVERT(varchar(36),s.unidad_negocio_id) ORDER BY u.codigo

queries.name: scheduler_finish_after_r7
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (20) JobName,RunID,Accion,FechaAccion,Exito,MensajeError,DetallesJSON FROM dbo.Scheduler_BitacoraJobs WHERE JobName='sync_comercial_v2' AND FechaAccion>'2026-09-28T23:37:58' ORDER BY FechaAccion DESC

queries.name: unfinished_after_r7
queries.sql: WITH x AS (SELECT RunID,MAX(CASE WHEN Accion='START' THEN FechaAccion END) AS started,MAX(CASE WHEN Accion='FINISH' THEN FechaAccion END) AS finished FROM dbo.Scheduler_BitacoraJobs WHERE JobName='sync_comercial_v2' AND FechaAccion>'2026-09-28T23:37:58' GROUP BY RunID) SELECT RunID,started,finished,DATEDIFF(minute,started,SYSUTCDATETIME()) AS age_minutes FROM x WHERE started IS NOT NULL AND finished IS NULL ORDER BY started DESC
